content.value: Use a stack map to show the effect of each of the following instructions on the stack pointer (08) and on the contents of the stack.

MOV SP, 0050H   
PUSH AX   
CALL STRING   
POP AX   
STRING PROC NEAR   
PUSHF   
PUSH AX   
PUSH CX 1 1 1   
POP CX   
POP AX   
POPF   
RET   
STRING ENDP
